narrative.incident_description: Suspicious activity detected on asset GOV-VPN-01 (hostname egov-vpn, sector govt). One authentication event was recorded. Compromise has not been confirmed.
recommended_next_actions: Confirm the scope by verifying the affected assets and determining if the observed activity is genuine.
Preserve all relevant logs; CERT-In directions mandate retention of ICT system logs for 180 days.
If the activity is confirmed malicious, isolate the host according to the incident response plan.
Assess reportability immediately; if the incident matches a listed type, the six-hour reporting window applies.
